runs.label: wheel-binding-and-static
command: import json,hashlib,importlib.metadata; from pathlib import Path; import lingshu_gate; r=Path(lingshu_gate.__file__).resolve().parent; assert r.is_relative_to(Path('<validation-current>/wheel-runtime/venv')); assert importlib.metadata.version('lingshu-gate')==lingshu_gate.__version__=='0.4.5'; expected=json.loads(Path('<validation-current>/frontend/static-manifest.json').read_text())['manifest']; actual={f.relative_to(r/'static').as_posix():hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in (r/'static').rglob('*') if f.is_file()}; assert actual=={row['root']+'/'+row['path']:row['sha256'] for row in expected}; print('0.4.5 installed wheel: 118 exact static files')
